summary: MISO files tariff revisions under section 205 on November 16, 2026, in a new docket, ER27-527-000, creating the Grid Responsive Integration Transmission Service (GRITS). It is a permanent mix of firm and non-firm contract demand service for large loads willing to limit their withdrawals. MISO says it cannot run before January 1, 2029.
ask: Accept the revisions effective March 16, 2027, 120 days after filing, with implementation in early 2029.

points.point: GRITS is a permanent firm and non-firm contract demand service for large loads that can cut their withdrawals.
points.quote: GRITS provides a permanent firm and non-firm contract demand-based, Transmission Service option for Large Loads willing and able to limit their withdrawals under specified price and reliability conditions.

points.point: MISO says it answers FERC's concern that no permanent contract demand service exists in MISO.
points.quote: the need for a permanent contract demand transmission service in the MISO region

points.point: The earliest start is January 1, 2029, because of software changes.
points.quote: the earliest MISO will be able to implement GRITS is January 1, 2029

points.point: Example: a 500 MW load could take 200 MW firm and 300 MW non-firm.
points.quote: a Large Load Transmission Customer representing a Large Load of 500 MW may desire to only take 200 MW of firm transmission service

points.point: Customers need not move toward firm service.
points.quote: does not require the Large Load Transmission Customer to progress toward firm service for any or all of its GRITS Load Limit

points.point: GRITS is not limited to loads served by a co-located generator.
points.quote: is not limited to Large Load being served by a co-located generator

points.point: Rates are still being developed with the transmission owners.
points.quote: to continue the development of rates applicable to GRITS in concert with the MISO Transmission Owners

points.point: A customer must request GRITS through the Large Load Project Review, the same study route as other large-load service.
points.quote: A Large Load Transmission Customer must request GRITS through the applicable LLPR process

throughLine.text: Filed under section 205 to answer the E-8 show cause order's call for a permanent contract demand service for flexible loads in MISO.
